data.definition:
* the rule = bftemplate/hr_2026-11-12/step9/out_s11w_full/precision_rule.json (byte copy of out_015_s11w's): the record's precision_rule_b1.json with only s2_syn
    replaced by sigma2_leakfree_a19 data.curves.lfr1 (the leak-free withheld-slab test in which the whole registration was made
    without the withheld tissue; the record's own sigma2_v3.py --also-flat, flat beyond its last depth). tau2 and s2_interp are the
    record's, so the interpolation ratio is the record's.
  * s2_syn.mm<x> = the curve at x mm by linear interpolation, constant below its first and beyond its last depth (as r057's f).
  * weight_ratio.mm<x> = tau2 / (tau2 + s2_syn(x)) (precision_b1.py's ratios_at); weight_ratio_interp = tau2 / (tau2 + s2_interp).
  * s2_syn_from_mm / s2_syn_measured_to_mm = the curve's first / last depth; s2_syn_min_brains and s2_syn_all_brains_to_mm = the
    curve's edge rule (sigma2_v3.py curves.edge3: depths reached by at least that many brains; all brains up to that depth);
    s2_syn_flat_from_mm = the first depth from which the curve is constant to its end.

precision.rule: w = 1/(tau2 + sigma2): per brain and voxel, photographed part r[phi/tau2 + (1 - phi)/(tau2 + s2_interp)], synthesized part (1 - r) m/(tau2 + s2_syn(D)); r = the cross-fade weight, phi = the photographed share, D = mm past the junction plane, m = 1 for a brain with MRI and 0 for one without (bftemplate/finish_t1.py = linc/construction/blockface_finish.py)
precision.s2_syn_curve: per-depth MSE of the leave-slab-out network's joined prediction against the withheld photographs, on the leak-free targets in which the whole registration was made without the withheld tissue (sigma2_leakfree_a19 curves.lfr1; 12 brains), adjusted for brain, isotonic over the depths reached by >= 3 brains; constant below the first and beyond the last measured depth
precision.weight_ratio_interp_note: unchanged from the record (precision_weights_b1_d2b_s8 interp_ratio): tau2 and s2_interp are the record's; only s2_syn was replaced
precision.units: the photographs' brightness per brain, (B - p1)/(p99 - p1) over its photographed tissue

s2_syn.index: mm caudal of the join (the clean cut face plane), along the seam normal (finish_t1: max(-seam_depth, 0) of the d3 products)

rule.units: the final caches' grey (tau2 re-measured on the B1 stage-1 build; sigma2 from d3_A_sigma2_pred_flat.json)

replaced.note: only s2_syn (and the ratios_at it implies, and its source) differs from the record's rule

data.scope: the end-of-step-8 average (its blockface channels) and every average of step 9 (the start, the three rounds, the final average; out_s11w_full); MMORF's steps 1-8, the step-8 member warps and the step-8 b0 channel (weighted by the cost masks) and the link stay of record
